COMVOR_SETTINGS.TITLE: Comvor AI
COMVOR_SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Configure your AI assistant's identity, knowledge, and behaviour.
COMVOR_SETTINGS.SAVE_ERROR: Failed to save settings. Please try again.

BUSINESS.TITLE: Business Identity
BUSINESS.DESCRIPTION: Tell the AI about your business so it can answer customer questions accurately.

OPERATIONS.TITLE: Operations
OPERATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Set operating hours, timezone, and regional preferences.

BUSINESS_DESCRIPTION.LABEL: Business Description
BUSINESS_DESCRIPTION.PLACEHOLDER: Describe what your business does, your products or services, and who your customers are.

BRAND_VOICE.LABEL: Brand Voice
BRAND_VOICE.PLACEHOLDER: Describe how the AI should communicate. E.g. friendly and casual, professional and concise.

FAQ_TEXT.LABEL: FAQ / Knowledge Base
FAQ_TEXT.PLACEHOLDER: Add frequently asked questions and their answers. The AI will use this to respond to customers.

TOKEN_BUDGET.LABEL: Token Budget Per Thread
TOKEN_BUDGET.HINT: Minimum 1000. Controls how much context the AI processes per conversation.
